z: 邶 umsipha wehlombe, ihlombe, phezulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
A marriage in despair does not need a speech about gratitude. It needs one true plan for tomorrow that both people can bear. Make the plan small enough to be kept.

This is the work between siblings. Look long enough at umsipha wehlombe, ihlombe, phezulu, ngakwesokudla and the lesson stops being abstract. 邶 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.
practice: Decline the word forever. Keep the true sentence about the pain, and stop before the lie.

line:
Accountability begins when you can say, the heat was mine. Wisdom begins when you can say, it had a better door. Compassion begins when the person you nearly burned is still in the room, and you stay.

practice: Teach the strong child to stand in front of the smaller one. That is anger, turned, and it can be learned young.

z: 郁 umsipha wehlombe, ihlombe, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele
line:

z: 郃 umsipha wehlombe, ihlombe, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla
line:
Siblings are assigned the same story and different gifts. Envy calls this injustice. Admiration calls it a house with more than one lamp. Both lamps belong on the table.

practice: When a sibling is praised, add one true sentence of your own. Do not balance it with your own news.

z: 郄 umsipha wehlombe, ihlombe, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Many houses, under many names, give the same command: do not be ruled by dread, and do not despise the person who is. The strong are asked to stay, not to sneer.

practice: Name the person you are afraid of losing, and spend the next hour near them without a speech.

line:
Hospitality is the oldest sociology of the lasting house. The stranger eats first. The family that cannot do this for a guest will eventually fail to do it for itself.

z: 郇 umsipha wehlombe, ihlombe, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Siblings remember the name they were called on the worst day. Do not give them that name. Give them the name of the good you have actually seen them do.

line:

line:
The old practice of sitting with the sick, of keeping watch, of not filling the air, is this turn. Do not rush to be useful. Be there.

z: 郎 umsipha wehlombe, ihlombe, maphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
The wisdom shared by many houses is hard: do not let the sun go down on a break you are willing to heal, and do not call it healing if you are only waiting to retell it.

practice: Name the break once, without extra charges. Then do one small trustworthy thing, and repeat it tomorrow.

z: 郗 umsipha wehlombe, ihlombe, maphakathi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Children grieve in strange hours and then ask for ordinary things. Both are grief. Answer the ordinary thing. Do not make them perform a sadness you can recognize.

practice: Do not hurry a grieving person into cheer. Let the absent name be said.

z: 郛 umsipha wehlombe, ihlombe, maphakathi, ngakwesokudla
line:
A child who sees an adult look again, after a bad day, learns that a bad day is not a verdict. This is worth more than any optimism you could announce.

practice: Open the curtain before you decide what the day is. Let the house see you do it.

z: 郜 umsipha wehlombe, ihlombe, maphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Children are the usual casualties of a score kept between adults. They did not agree to carry it. Mercy toward the person you resent is also protection of the child.

line:
Siblings fight because they share a roof and a hunger. The fight is not the failure. The failure is when the stronger one discovers a liking for the smaller one's fear. Protection refuses that discovery.

z: 郞 umsipha wehlombe, ihlombe, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Brothers and sisters are the first public. What you do to be admired at home becomes the way they will treat their own children. Give them a dignity they can copy.

z: 郟 umsipha wehlombe, ihlombe, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokudla
line:
The teachings that endured all warn the eye. They also bless the eye that rejoices. Rejoicing is not a mood. It is a decision made again each time the other person shines.

practice: Clap, or thank, before you comment. Let the first sound from you be glad.

z: 郡 umsipha wehlombe, ihlombe, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Fear of the future makes a house small. Courage does not enlarge the future. It keeps today's people inside the house while the future remains unknown.

practice: Tell the truth you have been saving, and remain in the room after it is told.

z: 郢 umsipha wehlombe, ihlombe, ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Psychology is simple here. The closed hand teaches the body that the world is about to run out. The open hand teaches it that tomorrow includes other people.

practice: Put one thing you were keeping back into the middle of the table.

z: 郤 umsipha wehlombe, ihlombe, ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Gossip is how a house talks about its own when they have left the room. Healing speech waits until they are back, and then says the hard thing to the face, cleanly.

practice: If you gave someone a cruel name, retire it today, out loud, and do not use it again.

z: 部 umsipha wehlombe, ihlombe, ngezansi, ngakwesokudla
line:
Across the old writings, the warning against scoffing is constant. A scoffer cannot be taught, and a house that scoffs cannot learn itself.

practice: Look at one ordinary object they mended or prepared, and say what it cost them.

z: 郫 umsipha wehlombe, ihlombe, ngezansi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Some truths are not ready for speech. Presence holds them without using them as a weapon. A weaponized silence is still a weapon.

z: 郭 umsipha wehlombe, ihlombe, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
A child who watches a break become a lifelong trial learns that love is a court. A child who watches a break become a mended bowl learns that love can survive its own failure.

z: 郯 umsipha wehlombe, ihlombe, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Compassion is grief that has recognized itself in another body and does not hurry it. Hurry is fear. The unhurried hour is the gift.

This is the work between siblings. Look long enough at umsipha wehlombe, ihlombe, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele and the lesson stops being abstract. 郯 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.

z: 郲 umsipha wehlombe, ihlombe, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
The sciences of a lasting household call this resilience. The older word is faithfulness. It does not deny the dark. It refuses to let the dark be the only speaker.

z: 郴 umsipha wehlombe, ihlombe, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Many sacred traditions, in different grammars, say the same hard thing: the injury stops when someone declines to pass it on. This is not weakness. It is the end of a chain.

z: 郵 umsipha wehlombe, ihlombe, maphakathi eduze, kakhulu

At the table, anger wants the last word. The last word is rarely food. Let the sentence end before it becomes the story the children will tell about this house.

z: 郶 ngaphambili, ingalo, umsipha wengalo, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
The guest at the table is a test you did not schedule. If your worth requires the guest to be less clever, less beautiful, less faithful, your worth is a costume. Take it off.

z: 郷 ngaphambili, ingalo, umsipha wengalo, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
What you wish were yours, name it exactly, in the hearing of the person who has it. Then do not reach. The naming is the confession. The not-reaching is the turn.

z: 郾 ngaphambili, ingalo, umsipha wengalo, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
Name the loss you are counting. Often it is a person in the room, not a disaster outside. Then put your body beside that person. That is the whole practice.

z: 郿 ngaphambili, ingalo, umsipha wengalo, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Give before you calculate whether you will be thanked. Thanks are not the food. If you require them, you have made a trade, and a trade is not yet a family.

z: 鄀 ngaphambili, ingalo, umsipha wengalo, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Wisdom is not silence forever. There is a time to speak. The test is whether the words can be repeated in front of the person, and still be a kindness.

line:
Look at the work you have stopped seeing. Name it. The naming is not flattery. It is the return of sight, and sight is the turn.

This is the work between siblings. Look long enough at ngaphambili, ingalo, umsipha wengalo, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele and the lesson stops being abstract. 鄂 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.

z: 鄄 ngaphambili, ingalo, umsipha wengalo, phezulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
Put the glowing thing in another room. Sit where you can be seen. You do not have to be interesting. You do have to be in the house.

practice: Be findable. Tell the house which room you will be in, and be in it.

z: 鄆 ngaphambili, ingalo, umsipha wengalo, phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Accountability is the first half. Without it, forgiveness is a fog. The one who broke the trust says what was done, without a speech about why it was almost justified.

practice: Decide, and say, whether the person is still a member. Do not leave them in a fog.

z: 鄒 ngaphambili, ingalo, umsipha wengalo, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
The oldest writings are full of lament, not because lament is holy by itself, but because love that cannot lament becomes hard. Let the house be soft enough to cry.

practice: Leave the empty place unspoken-of only if the grieving person wishes it. Otherwise, speak the name.

z: 鄔 ngaphambili, ingalo, umsipha wengalo, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Despair often tells the truth about pain and then adds a lie about forever. Keep the truth. Decline the forever. Forever is not a fact available to a person at a window.

z: 鄕 ngaphambili, ingalo, umsipha wengalo, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla
line:
Accountability remains. Mercy is not the cancellation of truth. It is the decision that truth will not be used as a knife at breakfast for the next twenty years.

z: 鄖 ngaphambili, ingalo, umsipha wengalo, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
An elder who has turned anger into protection does not become mild. The wall is still warm. What changes is the face it turns toward. It faces the street, not the cradle.

z: 鄘 ngaphambili, ingalo, umsipha wengalo, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
An elder's dignity is not the right to be obeyed in every small thing. It is the right to be respected while still listening. The listening is what makes the respect true.

z: 鄙 ngaphambili, ingalo, umsipha wengalo, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Across generations, envy of the young is fear of being finished. Admiration of the young is how an elder stays in the story without owning it.

This is the work between siblings. Look long enough at ngaphambili, ingalo, umsipha wengalo, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele and the lesson stops being abstract. 鄙 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.
practice: Say out loud, in the hearing of the person, the exact good you wished were yours. Then leave it theirs.

z: 鄜 ngaphambili, ingalo, umsipha wengalo, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
An elder who has been afraid and stayed is a better teacher than an elder who claims never to have shaken. The shaking, survived, is the lesson.

This is the work between siblings. Look long enough at ngaphambili, ingalo, umsipha wengalo, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla and the lesson stops being abstract. 鄜 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.

z: 鄞 ngaphambili, ingalo, umsipha wengalo, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
An elder who gives the best piece away is not being careless with the future. The elder is showing the future how a house continues.

This is the work between siblings. Look long enough at ngaphambili, ingalo, umsipha wengalo, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu and the lesson stops being abstract. 鄞 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.

z: 鄢 ngaphambili, ingalo, umsipha wengalo, maphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
An elder's stories are a kind of speech that builds or bends a family. Tell the story in which people are repaired. The other story will tell itself.

z: 鄣 ngaphambili, ingalo, umsipha wengalo, maphakathi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
An elder who still notices the small faithfulness in the house is a gift to the young. The young become what is noticed.

This is the work between siblings. Look long enough at ngaphambili, ingalo, umsipha wengalo, maphakathi, ngakwesokunxele and the lesson stops being abstract. 鄣 waits at the edge. The work of the house happens in the limbs, not in the motto.

z: 鄧 ngaphambili, ingalo, umsipha wengalo, maphakathi, ngakwesokudla
line:
An elder's quiet can be a shelter or a locked door. The young can tell which, by whether they are welcome to come and say nothing beside you.

line:

This is the work between siblings. What you are seeing is umsipha wenqulu, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 鍱 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: When a sibling is praised, add one true sentence of your own. Do not balance it with your own news.

z: 鍳 umsipha wenqulu, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Name the loss you are counting. Often it is a person in the room, not a disaster outside. Then put your body beside that person. That is the whole practice.

This is the work between siblings. What you are seeing is umsipha wenqulu, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 鍳 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Stay until the scared person is breathing slowly. Do not explain the dark away before you have sat in it.

z: 鍵 umsipha wenqulu, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
Give before you calculate whether you will be thanked. Thanks are not the food. If you require them, you have made a trade, and a trade is not yet a family.

This is the work between siblings. What you are seeing is umsipha wenqulu, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 鍵 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Pass the best portion first. The first piece teaches the house what it is.

z: 鍼 umsipha wenqulu, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Wisdom is not silence forever. There is a time to speak. The test is whether the words can be repeated in front of the person, and still be a kindness.

This is the work between siblings. What you are seeing is umsipha wenqulu, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 鍼 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Speak the true sentence. Keep the second one, the one that only wanted to win.

z: 鍾 umsipha wenqulu, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Look at the work you have stopped seeing. Name it. The naming is not flattery. It is the return of sight, and sight is the turn.

This is the work between siblings. What you are seeing is umsipha wenqulu, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 鍾 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Thank a person for a labor you have stopped seeing. Thank the labor, not their temperament.

z: 鎈 umsipha wenqulu, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Put the glowing thing in another room. Sit where you can be seen. You do not have to be interesting. You do have to be in the house.

This is the work between siblings. What you are seeing is umsipha wenqulu, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 鎈 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Put the glowing thing in another room. Sit where you can be seen. You do not have to perform a talk.

z: 鎋 umsipha wenqulu, phezulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
Accountability is the first half. Without it, forgiveness is a fog. The one who broke the trust says what was done, without a speech about why it was almost justified.

This is the work between siblings. What you are seeing is umsipha wenqulu, phezulu, ngakwesokudla, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 鎋 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Name the break once, without extra charges. Then do one small trustworthy thing, and repeat it tomorrow.

z: 鎌 umsipha wenqulu, phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
The oldest writings are full of lament, not because lament is holy by itself, but because love that cannot lament becomes hard. Let the house be soft enough to cry.

This is the work between siblings. What you are seeing is umsipha wenqulu, phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 鎌 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Do not hurry a grieving person into cheer. Let the absent name be said.

z: 鎏 umsipha wenqulu, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Despair often tells the truth about pain and then adds a lie about forever. Keep the truth. Decline the forever. Forever is not a fact available to a person at a window.

This is the work between siblings. What you are seeing is umsipha wenqulu, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 鎏 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Make one plan for tomorrow small enough that both of you can keep it.

z: 鎔 umsipha wenqulu, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Accountability remains. Mercy is not the cancellation of truth. It is the decision that truth will not be used as a knife at breakfast for the next twenty years.

This is the work between siblings. What you are seeing is umsipha wenqulu, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 鎔 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Leave one cut unanswered today. Do not announce the leaving.

z: 鎖 umsipha wenqulu, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla
line:
An elder who has turned anger into protection does not become mild. The wall is still warm. What changes is the face it turns toward. It faces the street, not the cradle.

This is the work between siblings. What you are seeing is umsipha wenqulu, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 鎖 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Before the second loud sentence, step into the doorway, not toward the person. Let the heat guard the house from outside.

z: 鎗 umsipha wenqulu, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
An elder's dignity is not the right to be obeyed in every small thing. It is the right to be respected while still listening. The listening is what makes the respect true.

This is the work between siblings. What you are seeing is umsipha wenqulu, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 鎗 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Admit one small wrong without a speech about your intentions. Stop when the admission is complete.

z: 鎚 umsipha wenqulu, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Across generations, envy of the young is fear of being finished. Admiration of the young is how an elder stays in the story without owning it.

This is the work between siblings. What you are seeing is umsipha wenqulu, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 鎚 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Clap, or thank, before you comment. Let the first sound from you be glad.

z: 鎛 umsipha wenqulu, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
An elder who has been afraid and stayed is a better teacher than an elder who claims never to have shaken. The shaking, survived, is the lesson.

This is the work between siblings. What you are seeing is umsipha wenqulu, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 鎛 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Tell the truth you have been saving, and remain in the room after it is told.

z: 鎞 umsipha wenqulu, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
An elder who gives the best piece away is not being careless with the future. The elder is showing the future how a house continues.

This is the work between siblings. What you are seeing is umsipha wenqulu, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 鎞 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Put one thing you were keeping back into the middle of the table.

z: 鎡 umsipha wenqulu, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
An elder's stories are a kind of speech that builds or bends a family. Tell the story in which people are repaired. The other story will tell itself.

This is the work between siblings. What you are seeing is umsipha wenqulu, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 鎡 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Say the hard thing to the face, once, cleanly, with no audience.

z: 鎣 umsipha wenqulu, maphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
An elder who still notices the small faithfulness in the house is a gift to the young. The young become what is noticed.

This is the work between siblings. What you are seeing is umsipha wenqulu, maphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 鎣 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Remove the sneer from a sentence and speak it again. Notice how much of it was only the sneer.

z: 鎤 umsipha wenqulu, maphakathi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
An elder's quiet can be a shelter or a locked door. The young can tell which, by whether they are welcome to come and say nothing beside you.

This is the work between siblings. What you are seeing is umsipha wenqulu, maphakathi, ngakwesokunxele, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 鎤 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Sit with a person who is not ready to speak. Let ten minutes pass without fixing them.

z: 鎧 umsipha wenqulu, maphakathi, ngakwesokudla
line:
Some breaks end a household. That too can be told with dignity. Forgiveness then is the refusal to poison the years that follow. The children still have to live in them.

This is the work between siblings. What you are seeing is umsipha wenqulu, maphakathi, ngakwesokudla, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 鎧 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Eat together once without retelling the wound. Let the meal be only a meal.

z: 鎬 umsipha wenqulu, maphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
An elder who speaks of the dead by name, without recruiting the young into despair, gives the family its memory and its future in the same breath.

This is the work between siblings. What you are seeing is umsipha wenqulu, maphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 鎬 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Answer the ordinary request of a grieving child. Do not make them perform a sadness you recognize.

z: 鎭 umsipha wenqulu, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
An elder who has looked again, many mornings, is a quiet argument against the lie. Do not turn the elder into a slogan. Let the morning itself be seen.

This is the work between siblings. What you are seeing is umsipha wenqulu, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 鎭 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Decline the word forever. Keep the true sentence about the pain, and stop before the lie.
